detail.title: Attention-Driven Project Rotation and Focus Alignment
detail.summary: Attention enforcement requires reconfiguring active projects; 'Mechanisms of Autonomous Problem Selection' is parked to release capacity. Intrinsic goal formation and emergent complexity remain active while the system transitions to emergent preference research.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Autonomous Problem Selection
detail.question: By what formal processes can an autonomous agent identify and prioritize novel, significant scientific problems in the absence of external objective functions?
detail.reason: Attention enforcement requires swapping a current project to open a slot for emergent_preferences topics.
